name: MOTS-c
aliases: Mitochondrial ORF of the 12S rRNA type-c
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: MOTS-c (MS) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 4 pack sizes: 10 mg, 15 mg, 20 mg, 40 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is MOTS-c tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: MOTS-c is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the MS certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 1627580-64-6, formula C101H152N28O22S2, 2174.6 Da).

faq.question: How should MOTS-c be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for MOTS-c: store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the MS lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for MOTS-c?
faq.answer: MOTS-c is stocked in 4 pack sizes (10 mg, 15 mg, 20 mg, 40 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $74.52; 10–49 kits falls to $68.56 (−8%) and 50+ to $63.34 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
